Name: Cutting Gale
Components: V, S, M (a feather dippened in sharpening oil)
Description: You summon currents of wind around your warm and lash out as if swinging a sword, sending a sharpened airslash foward. A creature of your choice within range must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer 3d6 slashing damage and be flung 30-ft into the air or down toward the ground. You may instead choose to shove them 15-ft in a direction while they remain grounded. A creature who passes this Saving Throw instead takes half the damage and is only moved 5-ft in any direction, but doesn't trip over or otherwise fall from any height if they are near a border such as a cliff.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you deal an additional 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.
